questions.q_en: 1. A person marks his goods 30% above the cost price. He sold 20% of goods at marked price, 60% of the remaining at a discount of 10% and remaining at 40% discount. What is his overall gain percent?

questions.solution_en:
1.(b) Let total quantity = 100 unit, cost price = 100

Total C.P = 100 ×100 = 10000

Marked price = 130

20% of goods sold at marked price

= 20 ×130 = 2600

Remaining quantity = 100 - 20 = 80,

60% of the remaining at 10% discount=

(80 × 60100) × (130 × 90100) = 5616 Remaining quantity = 80-48 = 32 unit Remaining at 40% of discount = 32× (130 × 60100) = 2496 Total S.P = 2600+ 5616+ 2496  = 10712  Percentage increase  = 10712-1000010000× 100 = 7.12% profit

कुल क्रय मूल्य = 100 ×100 = 10000

शेष मात्रा = 100 -20 = 80,

शेष का 60%, 10% छूट पर=

(80 × 60100) × (130 × 90100) = 5616 शेष मात्रा = 80-48 = 32 इकाई 40% छूट पर शेष = 32× (130 × 60100) = 2496 कुल विक्रय मूल्य = 2600+ 5616+ 2496  = 10712  प्रतिशत वृद्धि  = 10712-1000010000× 100 = 7.12% लाभ

6.(d)

l + b + h = 23 cm (दिया गया है) घनाभ के विकर्ण की लंबाई = l2 + b2 + h2  ⇒57 =  l2 + b2 + h2  ⇒175 = l2 + b2 + h2 (l + b + h)2 = l2 + b2 + h2 + 2 (lb + bh + hl) ⇒ 232 =   175 + 2 (lb + bh + hl) ⇒ 529 = 175 + 2 (lb + bh + hl) ⇒ 354 = 2 (lb + bh + hl) अत: घनाभ का कुल पृष्ठीय क्षेत्रफल = 354 cm2

According to the question,

x×143×517100 = 2× (14000-x)×4× 114100

34x = 2 ( 154000 - 11x)

17 x + 11 x = 154000

x = 5500

Amount invested in the second part = 14000 - 5500 = 8500

Desired difference = 8500 - 5500 = 3000

questions.q_en: 20. A seven digit number 736x46y is divisible by 225. Then find the value of 3x+2y (for maximum value of y) ?

questions.solution_en:
20.(c) Seven digit number 736x46y is divisible by 225, if this number is divisible by 9 and 5.

If this number is divisible by 9,then the sum of its digits is divisible by 9.

So, 7+3+6+x+4+6+y = 26+x+y

So, x+y = 1 or 10

Given number is divisible by 225 when y = 5 (maximum value)

So, x = 5 and y = 5

According to option

3x+2y = 3(5)+2(5) = 25

20.(c) सात अंकों की संख्या 736x46y, 225 से विभाज्य है, यह संख्या 9 और 5 से विभाज्य है |

3x+2y = 3(5)+2(5) = 25

let 11th number be ‘x’

10th number = x - 7

ATQ, 640+ 516 + 3x + x - 7 + x = 1804

1804 - 1149 = 5x

x = 131

questions.q_en: 52. In a certain language, FUTILE is written as EGTVSUHJKMDF. How will HELPFUL be written in that language?
questions.q_hi: 52. एक निश्चित भाषा में, FUTILE को EGTVSUHJKMDF के रूप में लिखा जाता है। उस भाषा में HELPFUL को कैसे लिखा जाएगा?
questions.solution_en:
52.(d)

Logic :- Each letter is coded by the letter immediately preceding it and the letter immediately following it.

FUTILE → EGTVSUHJKMDF

F → E and G; U → T and V ; T → S and U ; I → E and G ; L → E and G ; E → E and G

So, HELPFUL will be coded as ‘GIDFKMOQEGTVKM’.
questions.solution_hi:
52.(d)

तर्क :- प्रत्येक अक्षर को उसके ठीक पहले वाले अक्षर और उसके ठीक बाद वाले अक्षर से कूटबद्ध किया जाता है।

FUTILE → EGTVSUHJKMDF

F → E और G; U → T और V ; T → S और U ; I → E और G ; L → E और G ; E → E और G

तो, HELPFUL को 'GIDFKMOQEGTVKM' के रूप में कोडित किया जाएगा।
